name: brainmcp
description: Connect Claude Code to a BrainMCP server: a git-backed Obsidian vault used as long-term memory

plugins.name: brain
plugins.description: Registers your BrainMCP server as an MCP server, so Claude Code can search, read and (with a read-write login) update the vault

plugins.name: brain-token
plugins.description: The same server, authenticated with a static bearer token instead of the browser login — for giving several people their own revocable, read-only credential
